note: Routing battery for critical-thinking. FIRED means the stream-json transcript contains a Skill tool call selecting critical-thinking. should_trigger wants FIRED=true; should_not wants FIRED=false.

Sanity-check this argument: remote employees produce less because I see fewer Slack messages.
Which of these two launch plans would you choose, and what assumptions could make your recommendation wrong?
